title: Medical Data Extraction and Collection Tool for AI-Supported Antimicrobial Stewardship in Rwandan Primary Healthcare
description: Data extraction and collection questionnaire for AI-supported antimicrobial stewardship in Rwandan primary healthcare. Form version AMS-MR-EXTRACTION-v3.0 (Prof Nadine Rujeni 30/09/2026 revisions).
completedHtml:
Thank you.

The medical data extraction form has been submitted.

templateElements.title: Clinical indication for this antimicrobial
choices: Suspected sexually transmitted / genital tract infection
Indication not documented / cannot be determined

templateElements.name: clinical_indication_other
templateElements.title: Specify other indication
templateElements.visibleIf: {panel.clinical_indication} anyof ['Other suspected infection — specify', 'Other non-treatment indication — specify']

choices.text: Urinary: Urinary tract infection, site and agent not specified
Gastrointestinal: Infectious gastroenteritis or colitis without specification of infectious agent
General/Systemic: Bacterial infection of unspecified site
Skin/Soft tissue: Bacterial cellulitis, erysipelas or lymphangitis
Skin/Soft tissue: Deep bacterial folliculitis or pyogenic abscess of skin
Skin/Soft tissue: Other specified pyogenic bacterial infection of skin and subcutaneous tissue
